discovery: Discovery of geometric phases in quantum mechanics (the Aharonov-Bohm effect and the Berry phase)
rationale: After recent prizes in AI (2024) and macroscopic quantum tunneling in circuits (2025), the committee may turn to foundational theoretical quantum physics. Geometric phases underpin topological matter, quantum computing and modern band theory. They have long been considered overdue, and both laureates are elderly, which adds urgency.
